{"headword":"livestock","explanation":"「livestock」是一個集合名詞，指農場中飼養的家畜。在學測中，常出現在關於農業發展、畜牧業管理、環境保護或動物權益的閱讀文章中。注意此字為不可數名詞，因此不使用複數形式（如 livestocks），且動詞搭配需注意其集合名詞的特性。","senses":[{"sense":"家畜","explanation":"指農民為了食物、纖維或勞動力而飼養的動物，如牛、豬、羊等。","entries":[{"pattern":"livestock","pos":"noun","translation":"家畜","explanation":"作為集合名詞，泛指所有飼養的動物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the severe drought, the farmers struggled to find enough fresh water and grass to keep their <target>livestock</target> healthy.","translation":"在嚴重的乾旱期間，農民們奮力尋找足夠的淡水和青草，以維持他們家畜的健康。"},{"sentence":"Many rural communities depend on the sale of <target>livestock</target> for their main source of income and daily survival.","translation":"許多鄉村社區依賴銷售家畜作為他們的主要收入來源和日常生存之本。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"raise livestock","pos":"noun","translation":"飼養家畜","explanation":"名詞相關搭配，表示將動物從小養大從事畜牧。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the land was very fertile and had plenty of rain, the family decided to <pattern>raise</pattern> <target>livestock</target> on their large farm.","translation":"因為土地非常肥沃且雨水充足，農家決定在他們的大農場裡飼養家畜。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"livestock farming","pos":"noun","translation":"畜牧業","explanation":"指以飼養家畜為主體的農業型態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In recent years, modern <target>livestock</target> <pattern>farming</pattern> has faced increasing pressure to reduce its environmental impact and carbon footprint.","translation":"近年來，現代畜牧業面臨著減少環境影響與碳足跡的日益增長的壓力。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"farm animals","pos":"noun","translation":"農場動物","explanation":"較為口語且直白的描述方式。"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 live (生存、生活) 與 stock (存貨、資產) 組成，字面意為「活的資產」。","related":[{"word":"stock","pos":"noun","translation":"庫存；股票","explanation":"指儲存的物品或資產。"},{"word":"stockbreed","pos":"noun","translation":"純種家畜","explanation":"指經過精心篩選培育的特定品種。"}]}}

{"headword":"longitude","explanation":"「longitude」在學測中常與「latitude」成對出現，主要用於地理、航海、氣候變遷或探險主題的閱讀測驗。理解這個詞時，需將其與經線（縱向線）的概念聯繫起來，以便在描述地點位置時能快速辨識。","senses":[{"sense":"經度","explanation":"指地球上某一點相對於本初子午線（Prime Meridian）向東或向西的角距離。","entries":[{"pattern":"longitude","pos":"noun","translation":"經度","explanation":"指地理位置的縱向座標，通常以度數表示，用來確定地球上的具體位置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Navigators sailing across the open sea must constantly calculate both their exact latitude and <target>longitude</target> to ensure they stay on the correct course.","translation":"航行於公海上的領航員必須不斷計算他們的確切緯度和經度，以確保他們保持在正確的航線上。"},{"sentence":"The Prime Meridian is the line of zero <target>longitude</target> that passes through Greenwich, England, dividing the Earth into Eastern and Western Hemispheres.","translation":"本初子午線是經過英格蘭格林威治的零度經線，將地球分為東半球與西半球。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"at a longitude of...","pos":"noun","translation":"在...的經度","explanation":"用來具體指明某個地理位置所在的經度數值。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The international research vessel successfully anchored <pattern>at</pattern> a <target>longitude</target> <pattern>of</pattern> 140 degrees east to monitor deep-sea seismic activity.","translation":"這艘國際研究船成功停泊在東經140度的經度位置，以監測深海地震活動。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"latitude","pos":"noun","translation":"緯度","explanation":"指地球上某一點相對於赤道的橫向角距離"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 long (長) + 字尾 -itude (表示狀態或性質的名詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"longitudinal","pos":"adjective","translation":"經度的；縱向的","explanation":"由名詞 longitude 加上形容詞字尾 -al 延伸而來。"},{"word":"elongate","pos":"verb","translation":"伸長；拉長","explanation":"由字根 long (長) 衍生而來，意為使某物變得更長。"}]}}

{"headword":"lotion","explanation":"「lotion」在學測中通常出現在與健康、美容或日常生活中相關的閱讀文本中。它指的是一種液態或半液態的乳液，用於塗抹在皮膚上以達到保濕、治療或保護的效果。學生應注意其與 cream (乳膏) 的區別：lotion 通常水分較多，質地較稀，更容易推開。","senses":[{"sense":"乳液；藥液","explanation":"塗抹於皮膚上的液體或半液體物質，可用於保濕、藥物治療或防曬。","entries":[{"pattern":"moisturizing lotion","pos":"noun","translation":"保濕乳液","explanation":"用來保持皮膚水分的常見乳液產品。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To prevent her skin from becoming too dry during the cold winter months, Sarah carefully applies a <pattern>moisturizing</pattern> <target>lotion</target> every morning.","translation":"為了防止皮膚在寒冷的冬季月份變得太乾，莎拉每天早晨都仔細地塗抹保濕乳液。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"sunscreen lotion","pos":"noun","translation":"防曬乳","explanation":"特定用途的乳液，常用於描述海灘、戶外活動或皮膚保護的語境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before spending the entire afternoon at the beach, the family made sure to put on plenty of <pattern>sunscreen</pattern> <target>lotion</target> to avoid painful sunburns.","translation":"在海邊度過整個下午之前，這家人確保塗了充足的防曬乳，以避免痛苦的曬傷。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"medicated lotion","pos":"noun","translation":"藥用乳液","explanation":"用於治療皮膚疾病或緩解不適的乳液。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The dermatologist prescribed a special <pattern>medicated</pattern> <target>lotion</target> to treat the red, itchy rash that had appeared on the boy's arm.","translation":"皮膚科醫生開了一種特殊的藥用乳液，來治療出現在男孩手臂上的紅色、發癢的皮疹。"}],"tier":"tertiary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cream","pos":"noun","translation":"乳霜；乳膏","explanation":"質地較濃稠的塗抹劑"},{"word":"emollient","pos":"noun","translation":"潤膚劑","explanation":"專業術語，指能使皮膚柔軟的物質"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"lullaby","explanation":"「lullaby」在學測中常出現在文學描述、心理學討論（如嬰兒睡眠）或文化研究的文本中。它不僅指物理上的歌曲，更常被用作象徵母愛、安慰、安全感或童年回憶的意象。","senses":[{"sense":"搖籃曲；安眠曲","explanation":"為了讓嬰兒或小孩入睡而唱的輕柔歌曲。","entries":[{"pattern":"lullaby","pos":"noun","translation":"搖籃曲","explanation":"指特定的歌曲類型，通常具有重複的旋律和緩慢的節奏。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young mother softly sang a gentle <target>lullaby</target> to her baby, hoping the sweet melody would help him fall asleep quickly.","translation":"年輕的母親輕輕地為她的孩子唱了一首溫柔的搖籃曲，希望這甜美的旋律能幫助他快速入睡。"},{"sentence":"In many cultures, a traditional <target>lullaby</target> is more than just a song; it is a way for parents to express their deep love.","translation":"在許多文化中，傳統的搖籃曲不僅僅是一首歌；它是父母表達深厚愛意的一種方式。"},{"sentence":"The baby stopped crying and finally closed his eyes as the soothing <target>lullaby</target> filled the quiet room.","translation":"隨著安靜的房間被舒緩的搖籃曲填滿，那個嬰兒停止了哭泣並終於閉上了眼睛。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由動詞 lull (使平靜、使入睡) 加上名詞字尾 -aby (源自 by-and-by, 意為不久、隨後) 構成。","related":[{"word":"lull","pos":"verb","translation":"使平靜；使入睡","explanation":"指透過溫柔的動作或聲音使某人停止激動或入睡。"}]}}

{"headword":"lunar","explanation":"「lunar」是一個專門用來描述「月亮」的形容詞，在學測閱讀中常出現於天文學、科學探索以及文化傳統（如農曆）的相關文章。學生應將其與「solar」（太陽的）形成對比記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"月亮的；陰曆的","explanation":"與月球及其運行週期相關的事物。","entries":[{"pattern":"lunar eclipse","pos":"adjective","translation":"月食","explanation":"指地球位於太陽與月球之間，導致月球陷入地球陰影的現象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the rare <target>lunar</target> <pattern>eclipse</pattern>, the moon turned a deep red color as it slowly entered the earth's shadow.","translation":"在罕見的月食期間，月亮在緩慢進入地球陰影時變成了一種深紅色。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"lunar calendar","pos":"adjective","translation":"陰曆；農曆","explanation":"基於月亮運行週期的曆法，常用於描述東亞傳統節日。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people in East Asia celebrate the New Year based on the <target>lunar</target> <pattern>calendar</pattern>, which changes dates every year.","translation":"許多東亞地區的人們根據農曆慶祝新年，而這個日期每年都會有所變動。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"lunar module / lunar surface","pos":"adjective","translation":"登月艙／月球表面","explanation":"常用於描述太空探索、人類登月任務或月球地理特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The astronauts carefully explored the <target>lunar</target> <pattern>surface</pattern> and collected several heavy rocks to bring back to earth.","translation":"太空人小心地探索了月球表面，並收集了幾塊沉重的岩石帶回地球。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"solar","pos":"adjective","translation":"太陽的","explanation":"指與太陽及其能量、週期相關的事物"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 lun- (月亮) + 名詞字尾 -atic (表人或狀態的字尾)","related":[{"word":"lunatic","pos":"noun","translation":"瘋子；瘋狂的人","explanation":"由 lun- (月亮) 衍生而來，古代認為月相變化會影響人的精神狀態。"}]}}

{"headword":"outing","explanation":"「outing」通常指一次短暫的戶外行程或郊遊，常出現在描述學校活動、家庭聚會或休閒生活的文章中。","senses":[{"sense":"郊遊；短途旅行","explanation":"指離開家或學校，前往戶外進行短時間的娛樂活動。","entries":[{"pattern":"an outing","pos":"noun","translation":"郊遊；短途旅行","explanation":"名詞基本用法，指戶外休閒行程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To celebrate the end of the school term, the entire class decided to organize an <target>outing</target> to the national forest park.","translation":"為了慶祝學期結束，全班決定組織一次前往國家森林公園的郊遊。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a guided outing","pos":"noun","translation":"有導覽的郊遊","explanation":"結合專業導覽的戶外活動，常見於自然教育或參訪行程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every spring, the local nature club organizes a guided <target>outing</target> to help students identify different types of wild birds in the woods.","translation":"每年春天，當地自然俱樂部都會組織一次有導覽的郊遊，以幫助學生在森林中辨識不同種類的野鳥。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"excursion","pos":"noun","translation":"短途旅行；遠足","explanation":"較為正式的詞彙，通常指有特定目的的短途旅行"},{"word":"trip","pos":"noun","translation":"旅行","explanation":"泛指所有形式的旅行"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"副詞 out (向外) + 動詞 go (去) 的名詞化衍生字，字面意為「出去的行程」。","related":[{"word":"out","pos":"adjective","translation":"在外的","explanation":"表示不在室內或不在原處。"}]}}

{"headword":"outlaw","explanation":"「outlaw」在學測中既可作為動詞（宣布為非法/禁止）也可作為名詞（法外之徒）。學測文章中以動詞用法最為高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"宣布為非法；禁止","explanation":"指透過法律手段將某項行為、物品或活動正式宣布為違法。","entries":[{"pattern":"outlaw sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將某事宣布為非法","explanation":"及物動詞直接接受詞，受詞通常是危險物質或有害行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To protect the health of young children, the government decided to <target>outlaw</target> the sale of highly sugary drinks in primary schools.","translation":"為了保護幼童的健康，政府決定禁止在國民小學販售高糖分飲料。"},{"sentence":"Environmental groups are urging the city council to <target>outlaw</target> the use of single-use plastic bags to reduce ocean pollution.","translation":"環境團體正敦促市議會將使用一次性塑料袋宣布為非法，以減少海洋污染。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"ban","pos":"verb","translation":"禁止","explanation":"最普遍的禁止用詞"},{"word":"prohibit","pos":"verb","translation":"禁止；妨礙","explanation":"較正式的用詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"legalize","pos":"verb","translation":"使合法化","explanation":"將原本非法的行為或物品宣布為合法"}],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"法外之徒；逃犯","explanation":"指被法律剝奪權利、逃避司法追究的人。","entries":[{"pattern":"outlaw","pos":"noun","translation":"法外之徒；歹徒","explanation":"指逃避法律制裁的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In old stories, the brave <target>outlaw</target> lived in the deep forest and stole gold from the rich to give to the poor.","translation":"在古老的故事中，那位勇敢的法外之徒住在深林之中，並從富人那裡偷金子分給窮人。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fugitive","pos":"noun","translation":"逃犯","explanation":"強調逃避法律追究的人"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"outlawed","past_participle":"outlawed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 out- (超出/在外) + law (法律)","related":[{"word":"lawless","pos":"adjective","translation":"無法的；不守法的","explanation":"由 law 加上形容詞字尾 -less。"}]}}

{"headword":"petroleum","explanation":"「petroleum」在學測中常出現在環境保護、能源危機以及化學工業的討論中。它不僅指天然的「原油」，也常作為「石油產品」的總稱。理解此字時，應將其與 fossil fuels（化石燃料）與 refined products（精煉產品）等概念聯結。","senses":[{"sense":"石油；原油","explanation":"從地底開採出的天然礦物油，是製造汽油、塑膠等產品的原材料。","entries":[{"pattern":"petroleum reserves","pos":"noun","translation":"石油儲量","explanation":"指一個國家或地區在地下擁有的可開採石油總量，常出現在經濟或政治分析文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many Middle Eastern countries have huge <target>petroleum</target> <pattern>reserves</pattern>, which gives them significant power in the global economy.","translation":"許多中東國家擁有龐大的石油儲量，這使得他們在全球經濟中擁有顯著的影響力。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"petroleum product","pos":"noun","translation":"石油產品","explanation":"指經過精煉後產生的各種產品，如汽油、柴油或潤滑油。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Modern life depends heavily on various <target>petroleum</target> <pattern>products</pattern>, from the fuel in our cars to the plastic in our phones.","translation":"現代生活高度依賴各種石油產品，從我們汽車裡的燃料到手機裡的塑膠。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"burn petroleum","pos":"verb","translation":"燃燒石油","explanation":"描述能源消耗的過程，通常與溫室氣體排放或環境污染相關。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When factories <target>burn</target> <pattern>petroleum</pattern> to produce electricity, they release large amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.","translation":"當工廠燃燒石油來產生電力時，它們會向大氣中釋放大量的二氧化碳。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"crude oil","pos":"noun","translation":"原油","explanation":"指尚未經過精煉的天然石油"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 petr- (石頭/岩石) + -oleum (油)","related":[{"word":"petrochemical","pos":"adjective","translation":"石油化學的","explanation":"由 petroleum 與 chemical 組合而成，指與石油化學工業相關的。"},{"word":"petrochemicals","pos":"noun","translation":"石油化學產品","explanation":"指由石油精煉後產生的化學物質。"}]}}

{"headword":"pharmacist","explanation":"「pharmacist」在學測中常出現在醫療健康、社區服務或藥物安全相關的閱讀測驗中。學生應注意其職責不僅是「配藥」，更包含藥理諮詢與安全指導。","senses":[{"sense":"藥劑師","explanation":"經過專業訓練，負責配製、調配以及指導患者正確使用藥物的醫療專業人員。","entries":[{"pattern":"pharmacist","pos":"noun","translation":"藥劑師","explanation":"可數名詞，指在藥局或醫院工作的專業藥理人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the doctor wrote the prescription, the <target>pharmacist</target> carefully checked the dosage to ensure the patient would not have any side effects.","translation":"在醫生開出處方箋後，藥劑師仔細檢查了劑量，以確保患者不會產生任何副作用。"},{"sentence":"If you are not sure how to take your medicine, you should ask the <target>pharmacist</target> for professional advice about the correct timing.","translation":"如果你不確定該如何服用藥物，你應該詢問藥劑師關於正確服藥時間的專業建議。"},{"sentence":"The local <target>pharmacist</target> is well-known in the community for providing free health consultations to elderly people who live alone.","translation":"當地的藥劑師在社區中很有名，因為他為獨居的老年人提供免費的健康諮詢。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"druggist","pos":"noun","translation":"藥劑師","explanation":"較常用於美式英語，指藥局經營者或藥劑師。"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 pharmac- (藥物) + 字尾 -ist (從事某專業的人)","related":[{"word":"pharmacy","pos":"noun","translation":"藥局；藥學","explanation":"指藥物銷售的場所或研究藥物的學門。"},{"word":"pharmaceutical","pos":"adjective","translation":"製藥的；藥學的","explanation":"常用於 pharmaceutical company (製藥公司)。"}]}}

{"headword":"pharmacy","explanation":"「pharmacy」在學測中主要指提供醫療藥品之處。要注意它既可以指具體的「藥局」實體店面，也可以指大學裡研究藥物製備與使用的「藥學」專業學科。","senses":[{"sense":"藥局；藥店","explanation":"指銷售或調配藥物的實體店舖。","entries":[{"pattern":"pharmacy","pos":"noun","translation":"藥局","explanation":"可數名詞，複數為 pharmacies，指社區中提供處方藥或非處方藥的零售場所。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After leaving the doctor's clinic, my mother stopped by the local <target>pharmacy</target> to pick up the medicine for her high fever.","translation":"離開診所後，我母親在當地的藥局停下來，領取治療她高燒的藥物。"},{"sentence":"The small town has only one <target>pharmacy</target> that stays open twenty-four hours a day to help people during midnight emergencies.","translation":"這個小鎮只有一家全天候營業的藥局，以便在半夜緊急狀況時幫助人們。"}],"tier":"primary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"drugstore","pos":"noun","translation":"藥局；藥店","explanation":"在美式英語中極其常用，且常銷售其他日常雜貨"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"藥學","explanation":"指研究藥物製備、分發與使用的科學專業。","entries":[{"pattern":"pharmacy","pos":"noun","translation":"藥學","explanation":"不可數名詞，指學術領域或職業訓練，與作為實體店舖時的可數性質不同。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she is interested in both chemistry and biology, Sarah decided to study <target>pharmacy</target> at a top medical university.","translation":"因為莎拉對化學和生物都感興趣，她決定在一所頂尖醫科大學學習藥學。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 pharm (藥) + 字尾 -acy (狀態、品質或場所)","related":[{"word":"pharmacist","pos":"noun","translation":"藥劑師","explanation":"由 pharmacy 加上指人的字尾 -ist 延伸而來。"},{"word":"pharmaceutical","pos":"adjective","translation":"藥學的；製藥的","explanation":"指與藥物生產或研究相關的形容詞。"},{"word":"pharmaceuticals","pos":"noun","translation":"藥品","explanation":"pharmaceutical 的名詞形式，通常指製藥公司生產的大規模藥劑。"}]}}

{"headword":"pickpocket","explanation":"「pickpocket」是一個複合名詞兼動詞，由 pick (挑選/拿取) 與 pocket (口袋) 組成。在學測閱讀中，常出現於旅遊安全、都市犯罪或社會秩序等主題。","senses":[{"sense":"扒手；小偷","explanation":"專門在擁擠的公共場所，趁人不備偷偷從他人口袋或包包中竊取財物的犯罪者（名詞用法）。","entries":[{"pattern":"pickpocket","pos":"noun","translation":"扒手","explanation":"可數名詞，指代執行竊盜行為的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking through the crowded tourist market, the young traveler realized a <target>pickpocket</target> had stolen his wallet from his back pocket.","translation":"在走過擁擠的觀光市場時，這位年輕的旅行者意識到一個扒手已經從他的後口袋偷走了他的錢包。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"a skilled pickpocket","pos":"noun","translation":"技術純熟的扒手","explanation":"常用形容詞如 skilled, professional 來修飾 pickpocket，強調其行竊手法高明。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Police officers often warn tourists to be extremely cautious because <pattern>a skilled</pattern> <target>pickpocket</target> can steal your valuables without you even noticing.","translation":"警察經常警告遊客要極其小心，因為技術純熟的扒手可以在你甚至沒察覺的情況下偷走你的貴重物品。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"thief","pos":"noun","translation":"小偷","explanation":"泛指所有偷竊財物的人"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"primary"},{"sense":"扒竊；偷竊","explanation":"指從他人的口袋或包包中偷取錢財的行為（動詞用法）。","entries":[{"pattern":"pickpocket","pos":"verb","translation":"扒竊","explanation":"及物或不及物動詞，指行竊的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The cunning thief tried to <target>pickpocket</target> unsuspecting passengers who were rushing onto the subway train during peak hours.","translation":"這名狡猾的小偷試圖在尖峰時刻衝上地鐵列車時，對毫無戒心的乘客進行扒竊。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"steal","pos":"verb","translation":"偷竊","explanation":"泛指偷走財物的行為"}],"antonyms":[],"tier":"secondary"}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"pickpocketed","past_participle":"pickpocketed"},"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 pick (挑選/拿取) + 名詞 pocket (口袋)","related":[{"word":"pick","pos":"verb","translation":"挑選；摘取","explanation":"複合字的前半部動詞。"},{"word":"pocket","pos":"noun","translation":"口袋","explanation":"複合字的後半部名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"upward","explanation":"「upward」主要用於描述方向或數值的增加。在學測中，常出現在描述統計圖表或物理運動的文本中，可作為形容詞或副詞使用。","senses":[{"sense":"向上的；向上地","explanation":"指方向由低向高，或數值、趨勢不斷增長。","entries":[{"pattern":"look upward","pos":"adverb","translation":"向上看","explanation":"用作副詞，修飾視線由下往上的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the young boy gazed <target>upward</target> at the twinkling stars, he wondered about the universe.","translation":"當那個小男孩向上凝視著閃爍的星星時，他對宇宙感到好奇。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"move upward","pos":"adverb","translation":"向上移動","explanation":"修飾實體物體由下往上的位移。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The rescue team watched the drone <target>upward</target> move through the thick fog.","translation":"救援隊看著無人機穿過濃霧向上移動。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"upward trend","pos":"adjective","translation":"上升的趨勢","explanation":"用作形容詞，修飾名詞，描述數據或價格增長。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Economists have noticed a steady <target>upward</target> <pattern>trend</pattern> in housing prices recently.","translation":"經濟學家最近注意到房價呈現穩定的上升趨勢。"}],"tier":"secondary"},{"pattern":"upward mobility","pos":"adjective","translation":"社會階級的向上流動","explanation":"指個人提升社會經濟地位的能力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Education is often seen as the key to achieving <target>upward</target> <pattern>mobility</pattern> in modern society.","translation":"教育常被視為現代社會實現階級向上流動的關鍵。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rising","pos":"adjective","translation":"上升的","explanation":"最通用的描述數值或位置上升的詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"downward","pos":"adjective","translation":"向下的","explanation":"方向或趨勢完全相反"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 up (向上) + 方向字尾 -ward","related":[{"word":"upwards","pos":"adverb","translation":"向上地","explanation":"與 upward 意思相近的副詞形式。"},{"word":"forward","pos":"adjective","translation":"向前的","explanation":"同樣使用 -ward 字尾表示方向。"}]}}

{"headword":"urgency","explanation":"「urgency」在學測中常出現在描述社會危機或醫療急救的情境中，為名詞詞性。","senses":[{"sense":"緊急；急迫","explanation":"指某件事必須立即處理，否則會產生嚴重後果的狀態。","entries":[{"pattern":"a sense of urgency","pos":"noun","translation":"緊迫感","explanation":"最常見的固定搭配，指意識到事情非常緊急而產生的心理狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the floodwaters rose rapidly, the villagers felt a growing <pattern>sense</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>urgency</target> to move to higher ground.","translation":"隨著洪水迅速上升，村民們感受到一種日益增加的緊迫感，必須移往高處。"}],"tier":"primary"},{"pattern":"with urgency","pos":"noun","translation":"緊急地；急迫地","explanation":"用作介系詞片語，修飾行動的快速與決定性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The doctors worked <pattern>with</pattern> <target>urgency</target> to save the patient, knowing every second counted.","translation":"醫生們緊急地工作以救治患者，知道每一秒都至關重要。"}],"tier":"secondary"}],"synonyms":[{"word":"emergency","pos":"noun","translation":"緊急情況","explanation":"指需要立即處理的突發危急狀況"},{"word":"crisis","pos":"noun","translation":"危機","explanation":"指情勢危急的關鍵時刻"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"leisure","pos":"noun","translation":"悠閒；閒暇","explanation":"指沒有壓力且時間充足的狀態"}],"tier":"primary"}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 urg (推、催促) + 名詞字尾 -ency","related":[{"word":"urgent","pos":"adjective","translation":"緊急的；急迫的","explanation":"核心形容詞型態。"},{"word":"urge","pos":"verb","translation":"催促；強烈建議","explanation":"動詞型態。"}]}}
